note: What Instagram itself has said about reach, kept apart from what other people claim. The research agent adds to this on every run and marks each line: 'official' (said by Instagram or its head, with where we read it) or 'claim' (said by others, not confirmed).

notes.rule: For reels, three signals count most: watch time, likes per reach, and sends per reach.
notes.for_us: Judge every episode on these three, not on raw views.

notes.rule: Comments are not among those three signals.
notes.said_by: Same statement, as tracked by keywordseverywhere.com
notes.for_us: Our comment keyword is for the sale, not for reach. Each episode also needs a reason to send it to someone.

notes.rule: Sends (sharing a reel in DM) are the strongest signal for reaching people who do not follow you.
notes.said_by: Reported as Mosseri's position by several guides
notes.for_us: Write episodes people forward: 'send this to the person whose number is 7'.

notes.rule: Original content is favoured; accounts that mostly repost others get less reach.
notes.for_us: Borrow structures, never footage. Our own drawn series fits this.

notes.rule: At most five hashtags per post since December 2025.
notes.for_us: Not confirmed on Instagram's own page by our reviewer. Keep hashtags few and on-topic either way.
